rca_of_issue: Original bug: a single wide 3-panel reference image was rendered per card and horizontally clipped to show only one section, causing labels from adjacent panels (e.g. 'Exfoliative tology', 'Vaginos…') to bleed into the visible area. Fix replaces that with per-card dedicated visuals inside a fixed 96x96 rounded panel using resizeMode='cover' for images and Ionicons for icon-based methods. Confirmed visually and via DOM inspection.
